description:
RocksDB JNI built from official source with C++ internal symbols hidden via linker
        exported_symbols_list/version-script. Only JNI function symbols are exported, enabling safe
        co-existence with other RocksDB versions in the same JVM via ClassLoader isolation.
        Includes BlobDB API and all compression codecs (LZ4, Snappy, Zstd, Zlib, Bzip2).
